name: Point-Containment Voxelization
definition: A method to convert an AutoCAD Solid3d into a 3D grid of voxels by determining which voxels intersect the solid's volume. It uses a grid-aligned bounding box and checks the containment of grid vertices against the solid's Boundary Representation (Brep).
summary: Point-Containment Voxelization converts 3D solids to voxel grids by testing grid vertex containment against the boundary representation, distinguishing itself from methods using ray casting or stochastic sampling.
